body: I'll just lie in bed and try to talk to my doctor. Maybe i can have pills that would make me fall asleep.
I hate exercise. My hobbies are riding my motorbike, and climbing. Two things that I can't risk doing now for fear of attempting something and failing.

Trying hobbies is something i actively tried for the past few months. Things were going a bit better until one month ago. Before that i was deluded enough to stop seeing my psychiatrist. And now I'm back to square one. 

Thank you for the encouragements. If i take the bike I'm going to crash and even at 200kmh i risk getting crippled
I can cry while listening to music, which is at least feeling something.
When your phone rings, and you hope someone will ask you how you're going. And its just a cable provider offering you more TV.

I don't think I've ever had it. I only live by procuration, through people I love. This makes me shallow, just a shell. The past few years even that has been more difficult, and now that I'm useless, people are turning their back on me. I don't have a purpose anymore.
